text: Implemented Phase 9. Added direct locus Region and Selection to FeatureSet adapters, Parcellation to regional FeatureSetPlan, and CenteredSearchlight to searchlight FeatureSetPlan. Region/fiber/neighborhood order is ambient-domain order; Selection alone supplies explicit custom order. Legacy mvpa-spatial center/window constructors are deprecated, and ROI-window compatibility now lowers through a canonical locus searchlight. Added ordered locus Selection adapters for multivar IndexSet and RoiPlan while leaving algorithm semantics in MVPA/multivar. Verification: mvpaSpatial 12 JVM/12 JS, multivar 478 JVM/478 JS, mvpa 114 JVM/114 JS, mvpaDataset 6 JVM/6 JS; warning-clean recompilation passed.
